name: Spam Comment Remover
author: sahildadwal

sections.description:
Spam Comment Remover is a lightweight plugin that:
* Automatically deletes spam comments before they are saved
* Removes spam with fake names, links, gibberish, or non-English content
* Cleans all existing spam comments from the dashboard
* Removes the “Website” field from comment form
* Stops bots using fake emails or junk names
* Requires no setup — just activate and go

Donate

sections.installation:
1. Upload spam-comment-remover to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen
  3. Done! The plugin works in the background automatically
sections.changelog:
3.0

  • Stronger spam detection
  • Deletes existing spam
  • Activation notice added
  • “Buy Me a Coffee” link added
